name: Floppy
description: Floppy is a self-hosted media tracker and diary for movies, TV, anime, books, comics, manga, games, board games, music and podcasts, a private alternative to Trakt, Letterboxd and Goodreads. It keeps progress, ratings, lists, collections, a release calendar and yearly statistics, and fills in history from Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Pocket Casts or Last.fm.

notes.text: Sign in with DJANGO_SUPERUSER_USERNAME and DJANGO_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD from /opt/floppy_data/.env.
Registration is closed. To let others sign up, set REGISTRATION=True in /opt/floppy_data/.env and run systemctl restart floppy.
Movie, TV and anime search work out of the box. Game search needs your own IGDB (Twitch) client ID and secret under Settings > Metadata.
